description: Extract and reconcile portfolio KPIs, quantify performance variance and surface evidence-backed monitoring questions; no portfolio-company action or covenant conclusion without authoritative terms.

routing.when_to_use: Use when analyzing a portfolio company reporting package against its budget, prior periods, underwriting case or a provided covenant definition.
when_not_to_use: A different atomic task has its own skill
Requested output is an unapproved action or external effect
exclusion_rules: No system mutation or external communication
ambiguity_rules: Continue unaffected work and request only facts that materially change the result

required_inputs.name: scope_and_source_inputs
required_inputs.description: portfolio entity and authority; monthly/quarterly package; budget/plan/underwriting case and period; KPI definitions, reporting currency and units; debt agreement/covenant thresholds if requested; operational KPI definition/source; audience.

expected_outputs.name: task_work_product
expected_outputs.description: period snapshot with actual/plan/prior, variance amounts/rates, trend, covenant status only if definition and inputs complete, quality flags and questions for management.

forbidden_actions: Mutation of company, fund, Odoo, accounting, payroll or source records
Payments, filings, signatures, publications, messages, approvals, trades or transaction commitments
Inventing current law, jurisdiction, entity/fund applicability or missing facts
verification_steps: 1. Confirm the portfolio entity, reporting period, authorized package, plan version and audience. Do not assume this is Sara’s operating company. 2. Extract revenue, EBITDA/margin, cash, net debt, capex, working capital and only sector KPIs that are provided/defined. Record units and source cells/pages. 3. Reconcile values across statements and tie to prior period/plan; calculate variance=actual−plan and variance%=variance/abs(plan), marking zero denominator N/M. 4. Show actual vs budget vs prior for each KPI; separate adverse/favorable direction by metric definition. Do not automatically adopt the source’s green/yellow/red 5%/15% thresholds—use owner-approved limits or descriptive labels. 5. For covenant analysis, read the actual agreement definition, test date, baskets, addbacks, cure rights and required evidence; calculate only from matching inputs, otherwise mark not determined. 6. For multi-period trends, identify direction and magnitude without claiming cause; separate reported fact from question/hypothesis. 7. Deliver concise monitoring brief, data gaps and questions; no alerts/communications, lender contact, covenant certification or system update.
Show formulas/denominators, evidence dates and assumptions; preserve unresolved conflicts.
Write only a requested private draft; no external effects.
completion_criteria: Conditional task scope is evidenced or limitations explicitly bound
Task method and calculation are reproducible from cited inputs
Owner decisions, open issues and source limitations are explicit

telemetry.retention_policy: opaque task/source IDs and hashes only
